description: Sets the manual tracking/reference state for one exact order line using WAPI ManualTrackingIdSet. Requires confirmed=true. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

name: hgr_set_manual_tracking_id
title: Set Manual Tracking ID
